mostWorthwhile.text: Building the sky archive was most worthwhile: marking observation gaps made the important distinction between missing evidence and evidence that nothing happened.

leastWorthwhile.text: The fields-and-stores calendar was clear but fairly predictable; I wanted more detail on how lunar months align with the seasons.

surprise.text: The final passage's distinction between sharing a calendar and agreeing on the nature of the universe changed how I thought about the shared-calendar goal.
